verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. The comments now explicitly and accurately exclude tar-gzip from the fix instead of claiming `.tgz` support, while preserving the implemented ZIP inner-member-name behavior. The production path propagates `decoded.effectiveName` through the web-upload result and uses it consistently for both parser format selection and the displayed preview. The ZIP regression test is non-vacuous: its N-Quads fixture is invalid as Turtle and it verifies the resulting quad in the named graph, so it exercises the load-bearing format-selection behavior on the real browser upload/decompression path. The additional zstd test likewise verifies queryable imported data rather than merely checking for an absence of errors.
